messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **Canadian statutory holidays that create “long weekends”** in 2023.  
(For each holiday I’ve shown the actual date it fell on in 2023, and the full weekend that it extends.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Weekend created (if any) |
|---------|--------------|--------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** (observed) | **Mon Jan 02** (because Jan 01 was a Sunday) | Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 02 |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, PEI) | **Mon Feb 20** | Sun Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| **Good Friday** | **Fri Apr 07** | Fri Apr 07 – Sun Apr 09 |
| **Victoria Day** | **Mon May 24** | Sun May 22 – Mon May 24 |
| **Canada Day** (observed) | **Mon Jul 03** (because Jul 01 was a Saturday) | Sat Jul 01 – Mon Jul 03 |
| **Labour Day** | **Mon Sep 04** | Sun Sep 02 – Mon Sep 04 |
| **Thanksgiving** | **Mon Oct 09** | Sun Oct 07 – Mon Oct 09 |
| **Remembrance Day** | **Thu Nov 11** | Thu Nov 10 – Sat Nov 12 |
| **Christmas Day** | **Mon Dec 25** | Sun Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |
| **Boxing Day** | **Tue Dec 26** | Mon Dec 24 – Tue Dec 26 |

> **Quick notes**  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekday (e.g., Good Friday on a Friday), it naturally creates a three‑day weekend.  
> • When a holiday falls on a weekend, Canada observes it on the nearest weekday (usually the following Monday). Those observed days also give you a long weekend.  
> • Some provinces have extra statutory holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in NL, Heritage Day in BC, etc.) – those would add more long weekends for residents of those provinces.

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app!
